verified.description: Confirmed no GRDeelnemer, GRVerdeelsleutel, or bookkeeping-gr-consolidation already existed in lib/Settings/shillinq_register.json

GRVerdeelsleutel schema declared with sleutelNaam, costClusterAccountNumbers array, verdelingsType enum (vast-percentage/inwoner-aantal/gewogen-oppervlak/custom-formula), parameters object, lineNumber
